text: Jordan: Heads up — CI linkcheck failing on main after we converted headings to sentence case. Docusaurus build reports anchor duplicates and 404s. Marie: saw the job fail on #ci — linkcheck step. stacktrace shows "Broken anchor: #getting-started" for several pages. Sam: I think the root cause is we have duplicated autogenerated anchors from titles + explicit anchors in some legacy MDs. Alex: can you paste the failing log snippet? Jordan: sure: ``` Error: Broken anchor: /docs/guides/installation#getting-started Error: duplicate id "getting-started" in /docs/guides/installation.md ``` Sam: quick fix in a tiny PR: remove the old HTML anchors and rely on heading-derived anchors. Also added a small script to dedupe anchors. Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 Marie: nice. can we also add a short CI job to run a local anchor linter before linkcheck? running the full site on CI is slow. Alex: suggestion — add this to package.json scripts: ``` "lint:anchors": "node scripts/dedupe-anchors.js" ``` Sam: added a `scripts/dedupe-anchors.js` that scans for `
